about: England and its counties cut to a box round Hampshire and Wiltshire, from the planet file of 2026-10-26, read with GeoDesk, simplified to 0.001 degrees, keeping shared borders. England here is the counties joined, so it holds each of them. The counties: Wiltshire, Surrey, Somerset, Oxfordshire, Bath and North East Somerset, South Gloucestershire, Gloucestershire, Swindon, Windsor and Maidenhead, Bracknell Forest, West Sussex, Wokingham, Reading, West Berkshire, Portsmouth, Southampton, Isle of Wight, Hampshire, Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole, Dorset, Buckinghamshire.
